summary: Elevate your career in finance with our comprehensive Wealth Management and Private Banking Training. Gain essential skills and insights for success.
lede: Private banking training covers how to profile clients and build, monitor, and explain suitable wealth portfolios. This course is for professionals in advisory, portfolio, or private client roles who need a disciplined process for matching recommendations to client needs and institutional controls. Participants practice risk profiling, asset allocation, performance review using benchmarks and risk-adjusted measures, and clear advisory reporting, with attention to wealth preservation and succession planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in advisory, portfolio, or private client roles and need a more disciplined wealth management and private banking process.
modules: Client Profiling with MiFID II Suitability
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, calculator, and spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel. Participants should arrive with basic familiarity in investment terminology, client review workflows, and simple financial analysis so they can complete the hands-on portfolio and advisory exercises.
